主要内容: The document titled 'a1241326k.htm' is a Form 6-K filing by Royal Bank of Canada, a Canadian financial institution, published on January 25, 2013. The filing includes information about the issuance of $100,000,000 in Floating Rate Senior Notes, due January 25, 2018. The report is part of the Bank's shelf registration statement on Form F-3 (File No. 333-171806). The filing includes legal opinions from Sullivan & Cromwell LLP and Norton Rose Canada LLP regarding the validity of the Notes and U.S. federal income taxation. The document is incorporated by reference into the Bank's registration statement and serves as part of the disclosure for the issuance of the Notes. The filing is signed by James Salem, Executive Vice-President and Treasurer of Royal Bank of Canada.
